card.name: The digit 4 after a leading 4 or 2
card.fires_on: The digit 4 when it follows another digit, most often a 4 or 2 in a multi-digit number. It shows up in phone numbers, years, decimals and dose or radiation figures.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: A 4 inside the area code or exchange of a phone number.
modes.example: American Society of Radiologic Technologists (800) 44<<4>>-2778 http://www

modes.label: Years and quantities
modes.description: A final 4 in a year or a large counted number.
modes.example: defeat of the Christian army at Varna in 144<<4>>, when Cardinal Giuliano was slain in

modes.label: Doses and table values
modes.description: A 4 in a decimal or range, such as radioactivity doses or dosimetry tables.

card.plain: It marks the digit 4 appearing inside a longer number, such as a phone number, year or dose.
